name: codepanion_card
description: Adds one card for the user, or closes one: a check item (something pending on a topic, no time) or a reminder (a desktop notification at a time). Use kind check when the user says they have to do something, or a lens finds something left pending in a session; kind reminder when they say remind me at a time. With done true it ticks the item or marks the reminder done: pass the id from codepanion_pending as text. It never deletes; the user archives cards in the page. If the user did not say when, ask before a reminder; do not guess the time. Adding the same open thing twice returns the existing one. Returns the card id.

kind.description: check for something pending on a topic, reminder for something at a time (e.g. reminder).

text.description: The pending thing in the user's words, one line (e.g. Revisar el PR de pagos); with done true, the id from codepanion_pending (e.g. i-3f2a9c).

topic.description: What it belongs to: a watched project's folder name (e.g. tanka) or any subject the user names (e.g. facturas). Leave it out for general.

at.description: When, for a reminder only: HH:MM for today (tomorrow if already past) or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM, local time (e.g. 17:30).

done.description: true to tick the item or mark the reminder done instead of adding one (e.g. true).

evidence.description: When a lens found it in a session: the event it comes from, copied from the digest (e.g. 16:40 prompt: lo veo mañana). Leave it out when the user asked.

examples.text: Llamar a soporte por el deploy

examples.evidence: 16:40 prompt: los tests del login los hago mañana
